name: Orchestrator demo
author: Brett
description: Guided live demo of the Build orchestrator (demo-run@1): a start overlay (Continue, Pause between steps, Stop), then a scripted tour against throwaway demo-* builds: queue, launch, steps crossed off one at a time, a deliberate crash caught by the watchdog and retried, red CI with an auto-fix, merge-main and a dry-run landing, a build that dies for good with its break alert, stale-row cleanup and a demo phone notification. Before each act the console is focused on what to watch with a caption; at least 30 s between acts; with Pause between steps on it waits for Next. A summary of passed / failed / skipped acts at the end. Never touches a real build; a fake headless runner means no Claude account is spent.
